mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message, created_at) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, 0, #{message}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message, created_at, handled_at FROM friend_request WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status, message, created_at, handled_at FROM friend_request WHERE status = 0 AND ((from_user_id = #{fromUserId} AND to_user_id = #{toUserId}) OR (from_user_id = #{toUserId} AND to_user_id = #{fromUserId})) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.from_user_id AS fromUserId, fu.username AS fromUsername, fu.nickname AS fromNickname, r.to_user_id AS toUserId, tu.username AS toUsername, tu.nickname AS toNickname, r.message, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM friend_request r INNER JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.id = r.from_user_id INNER JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = r.to_user_id WHERE r.to_user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.from_user_id AS fromUserId, fu.username AS fromUsername, fu.nickname AS fromNickname, r.to_user_id AS toUserId, tu.username AS toUsername, tu.nickname AS toNickname, r.message, r.status, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM friend_request r INNER JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.id = r.from_user_id INNER JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = r.to_user_id WHERE r.from_user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_request WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_request SET status = #{status}, handled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM friend f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.friend_id = u.id) AS friend, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM friend_request r WHERE r.status = 0 AND ((r.from_user_id = #{userId} AND r.to_user_id = u.id) OR (r.from_user_id = u.id AND r.to_user_id = #{userId}))) AS requested FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id != #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND (u.username LIKE #{keyword} OR u.nickname LIKE #{keyword}) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT 20
